title: Grateful Dead Live at County Coliseum on 1973-11-23
lineage: CD -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Reel Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a fiery El Paso ’73 gig, highlighted by a scorching Jack Straw, soaring Eyes of the World, and Phil’s thunderous bass.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear, loud soundboard quality that lets Phil Lesh’s bass drive the music and showcases Jerry Garcia’s tight control on a blazing second set. Fans rave about standout moments like Jack Straw, Eyes of the World, Big River and Sugaree, while the first set is praised as dynamite and the overall flow described as vibrant early‑set followed by a laid‑back but still strong second half.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.4/5; comments consistently praise both the musical performance (especially first‑set energy and key songs) and the superior soundboard recording, giving a strong combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, off‑the‑charts sound with superb bass presence; reviewers recommend listening loud or on headphones. No major dropouts mentioned, only a slight comment about missing a bit of ‘umph’ from one reviewer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Vibrant, high‑energy first set followed by a slightly more laid‑back but still strong second set; Jerry takes control on the latter while Phil’s bass drives the whole show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for tight control and powerful playing, especially on Jack Straw and throughout the second set.
band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly highlighted for a thunderous, elevating bass that moves listeners physically.
